Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final production desktop application icon for Excaligo, for macOS Dock and Windows Explorer, a single square 1024 x 1024 raster icon.
Input image 1: user-supplied Excalidraw crossed drawing-tools mark, used as an identity and style reference. It is not a background to retain.
Primary request: create a distinct app icon that clearly conveys a Go-gopher-powered folder-management shell around Excalidraw.
Subject and hierarchy: one friendly recognizable cyan Go gopher peeks over and embraces a large purple file folder. The gopher's head, two round ears, big white eyes with small dark pupils, small oval nose and two simple front teeth are clearly visible. Two small paws rest on the top of the folder. The large tabbed folder occupies the lower half and reads instantly as directory management. Put the reference image's crossed pencil-and-pen motif prominently on the front of the folder in white with restrained pale-purple offset sketch details; preserve the recognizable crossed diagonal tools and circular hole in the pen. This is one cohesive compact emblem, not three separate stickers.
Style/medium: crisp flat vector-like illustration with softly rounded contours, a restrained hand-drawn edge echoing the reference. Professional, friendly, strong silhouette. Purple close to #6C63DE, Go cyan close to #00ADD8, white and very dark blue for small facial details. Flat solid colors, no gradients or 3D rendering.
Composition: centered, balanced, near-frontal folder with one visible folder tab, tightly grouped gopher and folder; fill about 84 percent of the square, generous consistent transparent padding. Simplified bold shapes that remain identifiable at 32 pixels. Gopher face and drawing-tools symbol must both be easily legible.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the silhouette. No white square tile, no checkerboard pixels painted into the image, no backdrop, no shadow outside the silhouette.
Avoid: text, letters, words, slogans, watermark, tiny UI details, extra folders or multiple mascots, circuitry, gears, coding brackets, busy directory-tree lines, photorealism, thin low-contrast strokes, cropped ears or paws.
Deliver exactly one finished icon, no contact sheet, no presentation mockup.
backgroundRetry: Use case: background-extraction. Input image 1 is the edit target: the finished Excaligo app icon, cyan Go gopher embracing a purple folder with the white crossed drawing-tools mark. Change ONLY the background. Remove ALL of the gray checkerboard pattern around the character and folder and replace it with a genuinely transparent PNG alpha channel (alpha 0). The checkerboard in the input is actual unwanted background pixels; do not redraw it or simulate transparency. Preserve the icon silhouette, its face, paws, colors, original drawing-tools symbol, placement and fine edge quality exactly. No other visual changes. Output one square transparent PNG cutout, not a mockup. The gopher and folder remain opaque including white eyes, white teeth and white drawing-tools mark.
finalProcessing: With user approval, a local Go program identified only background-connected neutral pixels (max RGB - min RGB <= 48). Enclosed white details were preserved. Following user feedback about rough edges, the external silhouette mask was Gaussian-smoothed (sigma 1.6, radius 4 source pixels), with a narrow fractional-alpha transition between coverage 0.30 and 0.70. Background-contaminated edge RGB was replaced by nearby solid outline ink. Internal artwork was not blurred. sips resized the transparent cutout to 1024x1024 and the web icon to 256x256. Wails v3 generates ICNS and ICO from icon.png.
